title: Higher Jacobi-theta bilinear growth minorants: unconditional local strict-growth sufficient conditions
status: The polynomial inequality is exact in its integral definition; the decimals are Gauss-Legendre diagnostics, not interval certificates. RH and E=0 remain unproved.

numerical_setup.precision: numpy double quadrature, mpmath direct Xi derivative checks

exact_theorem: For all odd n, all real x and 0<y<=1/2, G(x,y)>=y H_n(x), where G=(1/8)partial_y |Xi(x+iy)|^2 and H_n uses theta double-integral moments J_k^- for positive terms and J_k^+ for negative terms.
interpretation: Exact polynomial-root-defined positivity region; decimal root needs certified moment integration and interval root isolation. Every finite polynomial has negative leading coefficient and cannot prove all-height growth.
